faqs.heading: COMMON **QUESTIONS**
faqs.description: Still have something in mind? Just reach out directly.

items.question: How long does a website take to build?
items.answer: A standard website typically takes 1–3 weeks depending on complexity. Shopify stores can be up in 3–7 days. Custom web apps or mobile projects take 4–8 weeks. I always provide a clear timeline upfront.

items.question: Do you provide source files after the project?
items.answer: Yes — all project files, assets, and credentials are handed over upon completion. You own your code, your store, your app. No lock-in.

items.question: How do I provide project details and pay?
items.answer: Start by filling out the contact form below or emailing me directly. We'll have a discovery call, I'll send a proposal, and we go from there. Payment is typically 50% upfront, 50% on delivery.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Absolutely. I've worked with clients in the UK, across Europe, and the US. I communicate clearly and work across time zones without issues.

items.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
items.answer: Yes! Redesigns are one of my specialties. I'll audit your current site, understand your goals, and rebuild it better — faster, cleaner, and more conversion-focused.
